$description: Design tokens shared between the Obsidian plugin (styles.css) and the Android app (Theme.kt). Edit here, then carry the values into both files.

color.accentNote: Default. In Obsidian the accent follows the theme (var(--interactive-accent)); on Android it's customizable in the app, with a reset to default. The bright/soft variants are derived (mix 50% white / 60% bg).

font.headerNote: Nothing's proprietary font, non-redistributable: install it by hand. On PC install it as a system font (the plugin CSS uses it); on Android copy NType82-Headline.otf into android-widget/app/src/main/assets/fonts/. Fallback: Space Grotesk in the plugin, system sans-serif in the app. Glance widgets don't support custom fonts and use the system sans.
